sn7.15:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena Mānatthaddho nāma brāhmaṇo Sāvatthiyaṃ pativasati ||
sn7.15:1.3: so n-eva mātaram abhivādeti || na pitaram abhivādeti || na ācariyam abhivādeti || na jeṭṭhabhātaram abhivādeti || || 3.
sn7.15:1.4: Tena kho pana samayena Bhagavā mahatiya parisāya parivuto dhammaṃ desesi || || 4.
sn7.15:1.5: Atha kho Mānatthaddhassa brāhmaṇassa etad ahosi || ||
sn7.15:1.6: Ayaṃ kho samaṇo Gotamo mahatiyā parisāya parivuto dhammaṃ deseti ||
sn7.15:1.7: yaṃ nūnāham yena samaṇo Gotamo tenupasaṅkameyyaṃ ||
sn7.15:1.8: sace maṃ samaṇo Gotamo ālapissati aham pi tam ālapissāmi ||
sn7.15:1.9: no ce maṃ samaṇo Gotamo ālapissati aham pi taṃ nālapissāmī ti || || 5.
sn7.15:1.10: Atha kho Mānatthaddho brāhmaṇo yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā tuṇhībhūto ekam antam aṭṭhāsi || || 6.
sn7.15:1.13: nāyaṃ samaṇo Gotamo kiñci jānātī ti || tato puna-nivattitu-kāmo ahosi || || 8.
sn7.15:1.14: Atha kho Bhagavā Mānatthaddhassa brāhmaṇassa cetasā ceto-parivitakkam aññāya Mānatthaddhaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi || ||
sn7.15:3.2: cittam me samaṇo Gotamo jānātī ti || tatth-eva Bhagavato pādesu sirasā nipativā Bhagavato pādāni mukhena ca paricumbati pāṇīhi ca parisambāhati nāmañ ca sāveti
sn7.15:3.3: Mānatthaddhāham bho Gotama Mānatthaddhāham bho Gotamā ti || || 10.
sn7.15:3.4: Atha kho sā parisā abbhutacittajātā ahosi || ||
sn7.15:3.5: Acchariyaṃ vata bho abbhutam vata bho ||
sn7.15:3.6: ayaṃ hi Mānatthaddho brāhmaṇo n-eva mātaram abhivādeti || na pitaram abhivādeti || na ācariyam abhivādeti || na jeṭṭhabhātaram abhivādeti ||
sn7.15:3.7: atha ca pana samaṇe Gotame evarūpaṃ paramaṃ nipaccākāraṃ karotī ti || || 11.
sn7.15:3.8: Atha kho Bhagavā Mānatthaddhaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ etad avoca || ||
sn7.15:3.9: Alaṃ brāhmaṇa uṭṭhehi sake āsane nisīda
sn7.15:3.10: yato te mayi cittaṃ pasannan ti || || 12.
sn7.15:3.11: Atha kho Mānatthaddho brāhmaṇo sake āsane nisīditvā Bhagavantaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi || ||
sn7.15:7.1: Evaṃ vutte Mānatthaddho brāhmaṇo Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn7.15:7.2: Abhikkantaṃ bho Gotama abhikkantam bho Gotama || pa ||
sn7.15:7.3: upāsakaṃ mam bhavaṃ Gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatan ti || || 1. Sāvatthi nidānaṃ || || 2.
